articles.title: Heart, the Heretic: The Forgotten Visionary Jane Ellen Harrison on Critical Thinking, Emotional Imagination, and How to Fix the World
articles.highlight: 若要成为真正的异端，我们不只需要新的头脑，更需要新的心，尤其是由更广大的同情与更敏锐的感受所孕育的情感想象力。
articles.summary: 文章聚焦维多利亚时代学者简·艾伦·哈里森，她被主流遗忘，却提出一种更完整的革新观：真正的异端精神不只更换头脑，更要更换心，并孕育新的情感想象力。文章的核心线索是：这种情感想象力来自被扩大的同情心与更敏锐的感受习惯。对关心批判性思维与世界如何变好的人，这提供了一个常被忽略的视角。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：只升级头脑的批判性思维容易变成冷硬的立场之争；真正推动改变的，是同时扩展“感受他人处境”的能力。可迁移的提醒是：判断力来自理性与同情、感受力的共同训练。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "If we are to be true and worthy heretics, we need not only new heads, but new hearts, and, most of all, that new emotional imagination... begotten of enlarged sympathies and a more sensitive habit of feeling."

en.highlight: If we are to be true and worthy heretics, we need not only new heads, but new hearts, and, most of all, that new emotional imagination.
en.summary: The piece revisits Jane Ellen Harrison, a visionary who was largely forgotten, and her claim that real heresy requires not just new heads but new hearts and a new emotional imagination. That imagination, she argues, is begotten of enlarged sympathies and a more sensitive habit of feeling. It is worth reading as a counterweight to purely intellectual notions of critical thinking and of fixing the world.

articles.sourceExcerpt: EEG DECODING INCONTEXT: A FRAMEWORK FOR TUNING-FREEEEG FOUNDATIONMODELS Hao-Run Cai1 Si-Yang Liu1 Han-Jia Ye1 Hairong Zheng2 1National Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University 2Institute of Brain-Machine Interface, Nanjing University {caihr,liusy,yehj}@lamda.nju.edu.cn hr.zheng@nju.edu.cn ABSTRACT Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding is a central route toward brain–computer interfaces for communication, rehabilitation, cognitive assessment, and neurological monitoring. Recent EEG foundation models have substantially advanced reusable signal representations, but their downstream use still typically requires a task-specific decoder, gradient-based adaptation, and validation-driven model selection. We investigate a complementary foundation-model paradigm based on in-context learning: labeled EEG recordings define the decoding task as context, and new recordings are predicted without updating model parameters.

en.highlight: Create interactive Gantt charts with AI—no code required, free forever, with a built-in BYOK AI Copilot supporting 10 providers plus Ollama.
en.summary: The repository offers a no-code interactive Gantt chart tool with a BYOK AI Copilot (10 providers plus Ollama), free cloud rooms, working-calendar CPM, six views, and integrations for React, Vue, Svelte, Python, and MCP. With 6,241 stars and recent public activity, it is worth watching as an example of AI being embedded into a mature project-management workflow, and as a test of whether a free, multi-framework distribution model can drive real adoption.
en.failureAnalysis: Gantt and project-management tools are a crowded market, and 'free forever' plus BYOK may weaken willingness to pay while cloud rooms and maintenance still create costs. The AI copilot depends on users bringing keys and on model quality; unless it materially reduces scheduling and dependency work, it risks being treated as an ordinary Gantt tool, and enterprise permissions, compliance, and auditing remain adoption barriers.
